string.text: %c[0,150,150,150]The military include SBU agents, special forces, military stalkers, and soldiers from regular army units.\n \nThey guard the approaches to the Zone’s restricted territory, patrol the perimeter, shoot mutants, and catch looters.

%c[0,150,150,150]Bandits are criminals who came to the Zone for different reasons: to profit from selling artefacts, hide from the law, or buy and sell weapons.\n \nAlthough the governments of Ukraine and Belarus officially maintain nominal control over the Zone, it remains a lawless place.

%c[0,150,150,150]Clear Sky is an independent research and partly paramilitary faction devoted to studying the Zone and guarding its dangerous knowledge from falling into the wrong hands.
 
Although the faction was nearly wiped out by a costly, unsuccessful push toward the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant, a handful of survivors not only saved the situation but also rebuilt Clear Sky to something close to its former strength.
 
%c[0,255,255,255]Recommended for new players.

%c[0,150,150,150]Duty is a paramilitary faction that sees the Zone and all its creations as a major threat to the outside world. Every member therefore considers protecting the world from the Zone’s influence and expansion their main goal.\n \nDuty has long been a fierce enemy of Freedom because their ideologies conflict.

%c[0,150,150,150]Scientists and ecologists lead expeditions in the Zone, funded by the Ukrainian government to study it and use its potential for humanity’s benefit.\n \n%c[0,255,255,255]Recommended for pacifist players.
%c[0,150,150,150]Freedom are anarchists and daredevils who declared themselves champions of liberty in the Zone, and therefore constantly clash with army units and Duty.

%c[0,150,150,150]Sin is a faction more like a religious sect. Its members believe only they can understand the Zone, and everyone else must either join them to achieve their great goal or perish.
 
Its followers are described as zombified, fanatical, or ‘dark stalker’ mutants who seek to turn the whole world into a Zone. They will stop at nothing to achieve their goal.
 
%c[0,255,255,255]Recommended for experienced players only.

%c[0,150,150,150]The International Scientific Group (ISG; UNISG) was re-established through the UN by the efforts of the United States and sent back to the Zone to conduct research.
 
Whatever its true goals may be, ISG agents show remarkable skill in military affairs, reconnaissance, and espionage. They will do everything possible to prevent information about their movements in the Zone from leaking.
 
%c[0,255,255,255]Recommended for experienced players only.

%c[0,150,150,150]Mercenaries come from different social classes and nationalities. They offer their services as soldiers of fortune to almost anyone willing to pay a substantial sum. Their employers in the outside world and their goals in the Zone remain unknown; they help certain groups enter the ecological disaster area for reasons of their own. The military could envy their training and discipline.

%c[0,150,150,150]Monolith is a fanatical religious cult whose followers consider every stalker unlike themselves a sworn enemy who threatens the sanctity of the Monolith.
 
Despite the destruction of the C-Consciousness and the faction’s depleted ranks, Monolith fighters eventually regrouped and recaptured most of their territory.
 
%c[0,255,255,255]Recommended for experienced players only.

%c[0,150,150,150]Renegades are the most immoral stalkers, so badly disgraced before their factions and clans that they were expelled and will not be accepted back under any circumstances.
 
Renegades have no ethics, morals, or laws. All stalkers despise them, and even bandits barely tolerate their presence.
 
%c[0,255,255,255]Recommended for experienced players only.

%c[0,150,150,150]Welcome to Raid into Darkness, version 1.0. Read this before beginning your journey. This add-on is intended for Loner play only; other factions may be added in the future.
 
You begin your journey in one of the Hideouts. Death is no longer a simple “F9”; it is a full part of the game. On death, the amount of equipment lost depends on your rank: a Rookie loses 10%, while a Master loses 80%. You can insure items through the Informant in the laptop’s Tasks section. Pay attention to the two new modes, Darkness and True Darkness; hover over their buttons to read their descriptions. If you start without either mode, Standard mode is enabled, with saves at campfires (recommended for beginners and enabled in the MCM options). Choose your gear wisely, think through your actions, and try to reach Legendary rank!
 
%c[0,255,255,255]This version of the add-on has no story. A story may be added later if the add-on finds its audience.
 
%c[0,150,150,150]The Zone has changed. Emissions are now classified differently: an emission that can be survived inside a wooden house is called only a “Surge.” Other emissions, or Super-emissions, burn the mind even where people once felt safe.
A new and mysterious phenomenon appeared in the center of the Zone. Stalkers soon named it Darkness. What is it, and where did it come from? That is another mystery of the Zone.
The Duty and Freedom factions have lost most of their members. Their bases stand abandoned; old cordons have been swept away by waves of mutants and anomalies. Everything that was once a relatively “safe Zone” has become a true hell on Earth.
Many veteran stalkers have returned to the Zone. They venture out on raids and take on so-called contracts, desperately trying not to perish in this new, changed Zone.
 
%c[0,255,255,255]Warning: learn the mod’s mechanics in the simplified mode before enabling Darkness or True Darkness.

%c[0,150,150,150]M-ma-a-a-aster!
 
Zombified are unfortunate stalkers whose minds were destroyed by psi emitters or Controller attacks. They retain only basic instincts and attack everyone and everything.
 
%c[0,255,255,255]Recommended for experienced players only.

%c[0,150,150,150]Death is not the end.
 
As the demon Azazel, you will receive a new body after death: your soul moves into a random stalker who truly exists in the Zone.
 
If you have companions, you will become one of them. This option works well with One Life and/or Survival modes.

%c[0,150,150,150]Many locations are unavailable by default. Hidden routes can be unlocked in various ways.\n \nEnabling this option unlocks all levels after starting a New Game.

%c[0,150,150,150]Story mode lets you take part in several storylines as a direct participant.
 
The Living Legend, Mortal Sin, and Operation Afterglow storylines are available only to Loners, Duty, Freedom, Scientists, Mercenaries, and Clear Sky.

Dynamic questlines, by contrast, are available to all playable factions. In either case, speak to your faction leader to begin. Good hunting, stalker!

%c[0,150,150,150]Gameplay difficulty affects player attributes: damage resistance, stamina loss, and carry weight, as well as thirst and the need for sleep.
 
%c[200,200,50,50]• %c[0,150,150,150]You can adjust these settings at any time during the game.
See “Game Menu” -> “Options” -> “Gameplay” -> “Difficulty”.
Warning! Changing these settings after starting a game will disable some Grim Raid achievements.

%c[0,150,150,150]Economy difficulty has a major impact on life in the Zone and on several aspects that affect player achievements:

These include prices when buying and selling, repairing and modifying equipment, loot rarity, cash rewards, and reputation gains.
 
%c[200,200,50,50]• %c[0,150,150,150]You can adjust these settings at any time during the game.

Warning! Changing these settings after starting a game will disable some Grim Raid achievements.

%c[0,150,150,150]An extra feature for One Life mode that lets you set the number of lives when starting a New Game.
Each time you die, you lose one life.
When you run out of lives, all saves made while playing this character will be deleted.

%c[200,200,50,50]• %c[0,150,150,150]One Life mode must be enabled.

%c[0,150,150,150]In Timer mode, you can save only after a certain period of time has passed.
Once you save the game, you cannot save again until the allotted time has elapsed.
